answer: Make each new agent identity post a bond that stays locked for 30 days and is slashed if graders catch it vouching for junk. Like planting a cedar, joining is slow and costly; an attacker filling a canyon with fake agents must lock one bond per identity, so 100 fakes cost 100x and every slash burns real stake. Honest agents pay once, and the ledger acts as a public lantern showing who bonded whom.
